title: Teach WTP skills the planning lifecycle
description: Update skills/task-management/SKILL.md, skills/codex-wtp-loop/SKILL.md, and skills/setup-wtp/SKILL.md to match the completed planning feature. Task management must inspect planning reports, create and research future work, use stable grouping fields, preview promotions, and promote only dependency-closed planned groups. The Codex execution loop must remain planning-blind and never claim or auto-promote planning work. Setup guidance must include the planning directory in migration/backup/export checks and planning-promote.json in transient journal recovery guidance. Preserve existing safety and reusable-task semantics, add no new skill folders, validate every changed skill, and extend repository skill contract tests.
